I wrote `component.html` in the audit folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It has the "Audit log" heading, the "Date range" select showing "Last 7 days", and the eight events in your order and wording. The events are in a table with time, person and action columns and 52px rows.

I inlined `tokens.css` and used only its tokens, so the file is self-contained with no JavaScript.

I followed `DESIGN.md` for the page layout (white page, one centered column), the form field style and the table style.

- **Added column headers:** The Time / Person / Action header row is not in your content. I added it because `DESIGN.md` calls for a header row on tables. Remove it if you want strictly your content.
- **No primary action:** `DESIGN.md` wants one primary action at the top right, but your content has none, so I left it out. I did the same for the top navigation bar.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't bundled in the folder, so they fall back to system-ui.
